term: same-model structural omission of the no-component-first-being interface
definition: Structural omission of ledger L on the unchanged ORIGINAL four-being #681 joint interpretation, using the existing DirectEsseGenusOmissionControl.profile view (old ontic and old supportsEsse; all four candidates stipulated concrete). Check all thirteen nonlogical inputs other than L, with EM explicitly retained as the fourteenth input. Old roots left/right remain actual necessary first beings, noncomposite and represented essence/esse-identical, yet each is a component of the instrument. L therefore fails in this SAME interpretation. Newly assign only the previously unspecified HasIntellect and HasWill predicates false. The q14 reading still holds: nonroots are matter-form composites, while roots fail remoteness because they enter the instrument; q19 holds vacuously under false intellect. No actual selected root has intellect, so the full same-witness intellect/will endpoint fails. Contingent-ground coverage is vacuous in the old all-present ontology; no q3a8 part-freeness or independent philosophical adequacy is claimed. This distinguishes noncomposition from remoteness and shows L is not entailed by the other fourteen exact inputs in this profile, not indispensability in every route or a metaphysically possible unintellectual ultimate reality.
note: Reuse existing meanings of IsSimple, IsFirstBeing, RemoteFromAll, HasIntellect and HasWill. No new metaphysical relation or source attribution. Original fields remain unchanged in the omission interpretation; false primitive assignments are accompanied by explicit retained q14/q19 interface checks.
